Documentation/Scripting

Scripting

Stable Engine Doppio Last verified: 2026-11-18 Source: script/ScriptEngine.hpp

Caffeine scripts gameplay in Lua 5.4 through sol2, runs visual logic as Dryad node scripts, and keeps C++/native hooks available for hot paths. One ScriptSystem drives all four kinds in play mode.

What is implemented#

KindComponentSource
Lua scriptScriptComponent { scriptPath }.lua file, one environment per script path
Dryad node scriptScriptComponent with a .dyd pathNode graph compiled and hosted by DryadHost
Native scriptNativeScriptComponentC++ callbacks registered at runtime
C++ script classCppScriptComponentCppScriptRegistry / CppScript
Post-process driverPostProcessComponent + scriptonPostProcess(entityId, dt, api), falls back to onUpdate

The engine build enables scripting with CAFFEINE_ENABLE_SCRIPTING=ON (the default). Lua 5.4 and sol2 are fetched during configure.

Lifecycle#

ScriptSystem::onUpdate runs once per play-mode frame. For each entity with a script component it calls, when present:

Hook When
onCreate(entityId) First frame after the script is attached
onUpdate(entityId, dt) Every scaled play-mode frame
onFixedUpdate(entityId, dt) Fixed simulation step (default 60 Hz)
onCollision(entityId, otherId) 2D physics collision
onDestroy(entityId) Before the entity is destroyed
onPostProcess(entityId, dt, api) Post-process driver; falls back to onUpdate

Missing hooks are a no-op. Lua errors are caught and logged; they do not crash the application. ScriptSystem::resetPlayState() clears the initialized entity lists when play mode restarts.

Lua#

The global caffeine table is registered once in ScriptEngine::init() and shared by game scripts and editor plugins. Highlights:

  • caffeine.time — delta, unscaled delta, fixed delta, time scale, pause, frame, seed.
  • caffeine.pick — world/screen picking, mouse, 3D raycast, custom pickers.
  • caffeine.draw2d — world/screen lines, circles, rectangles and polygons.
  • caffeine.ui — runtime retained UI.
  • caffeine.assets — text assets.
  • caffeine.events — subscribe/emit game events.
  • caffeine.component — generic reflection-based component access (Lua and Dryad).
  • Full reference of every function, grouped by namespace: API reference.
  • Lua/Dryad parity, the new caffeine.math 3D helpers, the Dryad caffeine_time_*, caffeine_input_* and caffeine_world_* natives, and the roadmap: api-roadmap.md.
  • caffeine.map, caffeine.native, caffeine.postprocess, caffeine.forwardrender, caffeine.material.

See Lua runtime APIs for signatures and examples, and generic component access for the reflection API.

lua
function onCreate(entity)
    caffeine.debug.log("spawned " .. entity)
end

function onUpdate(entity, dt)
    local body = caffeine.component.get(entity, "Rigid Body 2D")
    if body then
        body["Linear velocity"] = { x = 4.0, y = body["Linear velocity"].y }
        caffeine.component.set(entity, "Rigid Body 2D", body)
    end
end

Dryad#

Dryad is a visual node script (.dyd) interpreted by DryadHost. The Doppio Dryad Nodes tab edits the graph and can round-trip it; the engine compiles and runs it with the same lifecycle hooks. The node catalogue and emitter live in src/caffeine/script/nodes/.

See the Dryad node scripts plan for the graph model and the Doppio editor notes.

Paths and hot reload#

ScriptEngine::setSearchRoot and ScriptSystem::setProjectRoot resolve project-relative paths such as scripts/player.lua or scripts/player.dyd. loadScriptAs(key, path) loads one file into a separate environment, so the same file can back several roles without sharing globals. reloadScript / DryadHost::reloadIfChanged reload from disk without restarting the engine; the editor calls them when the file changes.

Sandboxing#

Scripts are intended to run with a restricted standard library: os.*, io.*, load/loadstring and debug.* are not part of the gameplay surface. Game code uses the caffeine.* APIs, math, string, table, require and pcall/xpcall. Editor-only code (build tools, asset importers) may opt into broader access; gameplay scripts should not depend on it.

File map#

File Purpose
ScriptEngine.hpp / .cpp Lua VM, binding registration, load/reload and lifecycle calls
ScriptSystem.hpp / .cpp Per-frame dispatch for Lua, Dryad, native, C++ and post-process scripts
RuntimeScriptBindings.cpp caffeine.time, pick, draw2d, ui, assets, events, map, native
ComponentBindings.cpp Generic component reflection bridge
DryadHost.hpp / .cpp Dryad interpreter host
ScriptTypes.hpp ScriptComponent, NativeScriptComponent, CppScriptComponent
nodes/ Dryad node catalogue, graph, emitter and round-trip
ScriptWatcher.cpp File-change detection for hot reload
